```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
source(here("setup.R"))
source(here("functions", "data_cleaners.R"))
source(here("functions", "lfs_panel.R"))

```

## Import Data
```{r}
path <- here(
  "data", "quarterly_lfs_raw", "UKDA-9569-tab", "tab",
  "lfsp_jm26_eul_pwt24.tab"
)

lfs_raw <- read.delim(path, header = TRUE)
lfs_shrunk <- shrink_lfs_cs(lfs_raw)
lfs <- decode_lfs_cs(lfs_shrunk)

dim(lfs_raw)
dim(lfs)
attr(lfs, "source_variables")

```

```{r}
lfs %>%
  summarise(across(everything(), ~ mean(is.na(.x)))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "share_na") %>%
  arrange(desc(share_na))
```

```{r}
ggplot(lfs, aes(x = AGE)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30) +

```

## Test the residence-quarter panel

This is the same build as `pipeline/prep_data.R`: calendar quarters from 2014 onward. A file in that window which is not `jm`, `aj`, `js`, or `od` stops the build.

```{r}
panel <- build_residence_quarter_panel(
  here("data", "quarterly_lfs_raw"),
  from_year = 2014L
)

out <- here("data", "processed", "residence_quarter_panel.csv")
dir.create(dirname(out), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
readr::write_csv(panel, out)

dim(panel)
count(panel, year, quarter, quarter_code)
count(panel, residence)
```

```{r, fig.height=2}
# UK-born, EU-born, and non-EU-born. CRYOX7 through 2017 Q2, then the
# same three groups from CRYOX7_EUL_Main.
birth <- panel %>%
  transmute(
    residence,
    year,
    quarter,
    time = year + (quarter - 1) / 4,
    `UK-born` = 100 * share_birth_uk,
    `EU-born` = 100 * share_birth_eu,
    Other = 100 * (share_birth_other_europe+share_birth_asia+ share_birth_rest)
  )

birth_new <- birth %>%
  mutate(EU_born_ratio = `EU-born`/`UK-born`, 
         non_EU_born_ratio = Other/`UK-born`) %>%
  glimpse

birth_long <- birth_new %>%
  pivot_longer(
    c(EU_born_ratio,non_EU_born_ratio),
    names_to = "origin",
    values_to = "ratio"
  ) %>% glimpse

for (area in unique(birth$residence)) {
  print(
    ggplot(filter(birth_long, residence == area), aes(time, ratio, colour = origin)) +
      geom_vline(xintercept = 2021, linewidth = 0.3) +
      geom_line() +
      labs(title = area, x = NULL, y = "Percent", colour = NULL)
  )
}


```

```{r}
# First stage after 2020 Q4.
# Endogenous: change in the non-EU/native ratio from the previous quarter.
#   non_EU_born_ratio is non-EU-born / UK-born.
# Instrument: that area's average ratio over 2017-2019, times the national
#   change in the same ratio. The national ratio is the population-weighted
#   total. This is the one-group version of the Dustmann, Frattini and
#   Preston (2013) shift-share.
# Jaeger, Ruist and Stuhler (2019): the baseline share does not change, so
#   the shift-share is serially correlated. The lag of the instrument is
#   included. Residence and quarter fixed effects. Standard errors clustered
#   by residence area.
# The last number is the cluster-robust F statistic on the current instrument.
local_ratio <- birth_new %>%
  transmute(residence, year, quarter, time, ratio = non_EU_born_ratio) %>%
  arrange(residence, year, quarter) %>%
  group_by(residence) %>%
  mutate(d_ratio = ratio - lag(ratio)) %>%
  ungroup()

national <- panel %>%
  group_by(year, quarter) %>%
  summarise(
    national_ratio = sum(pop * (share_birth_other_europe+share_birth_asia+ share_birth_rest), na.rm = TRUE) /
      sum(pop * share_birth_uk, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  arrange(year, quarter) %>%
  mutate(
    g = national_ratio - lag(national_ratio),
    g_lag = lag(g)
  )

baseline <- local_ratio %>%
  filter(year >= 2017, year <= 2019) %>%
  group_by(residence) %>%
  summarise(baseline = mean(ratio, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

post <- local_ratio %>%
  filter(time > 2020 + 3 / 4) %>%
  inner_join(baseline, by = "residence") %>%
  inner_join(select(national, year, quarter, g, g_lag), by = c("year", "quarter")) %>%
  mutate(
    shift_share = baseline * g,
    shift_share_lag = baseline * g_lag
  )

first_stage <- feols(
  d_ratio ~ shift_share + shift_share_lag | residence + year^quarter,
  data = post,
  vcov = ~ residence
)

baseline
summary(first_stage)
coeftable(first_stage)["shift_share", "t value"]^2
```
